# TeamOps — HR for Jira (Leave, Onboarding & Offboarding)

> TeamOps is a Forge-native Atlassian app from PPLX Software that runs HR operations inside Jira: employee onboarding, leave/PTO tracking, team availability, and offboarding. Because it is built on Atlassian Forge, HR data stays inside Atlassian's infrastructure rather than being processed by an external server. Free for teams up to 10 users; Pro starts at $2/user/month (founding-member rate).

## Key facts
- Free for teams up to 10 users. Pro starts at $2/user/month (founding-member rate); the $4/user/month standard rate is not yet active.
- Forge-native: HR data stays inside Atlassian's infrastructure. TeamOps is not a Connect app, so leave and onboarding data is not processed on an external vendor's servers.
- Covers employee onboarding, leave/PTO tracking, team availability ("who's out"), and offboarding in one app inside Jira.
- 7 templates (5 onboarding + 2 offboarding) with 140 pre-built tasks. Typical setup in 60 seconds.
- Holidays pre-loaded for 6 countries (US, UK, Canada, Australia, India, Germany).
- Ships a Rovo agent with 9 HR actions (Rovo requires Jira Premium or Enterprise plan).
- Most HR apps bolt onto Jira from outside; TeamOps runs natively on Atlassian and ships a Rovo agent so your team can manage onboarding and leave in the tools they already use.
- Marketplace listing: https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/522828381
